what: Quasi-isodynamic stellarator fusion power plants (Max Planck IPP spin-out).

membership.basis: Live tomorrow.vc portfolio; tech.eu names the Visionaries Tomorrow fund in the pre-seed extension; Tomorrow Fund I appears in Proxima Fusion GmbH's shareholder list of 2023-12-14 (North Data).
membership.quote: many of them via the Visionaries Tomorrow fund

notes: Visionaries Tomorrow was not in the May 2023 pre-seed as reported (Plural/UVC co-led); it came in through the Nov 2023 extension (tech.eu) and appears in the Proxima Fusion GmbH shareholder list dated 2023-12-14 (North Data, Tomorrow Fund I HRA 60243 B). It doubled down in the EUR 20M seed and joined the EUR 130M Series A. Valuation agrees with the Balderton, Lightspeed and Cherry rows (EUR 2.4B, Jul 2026). Founded year not re-cited (left empty).
